scientific_question: Among broad PIT-eligible A-share stocks, does downside-specific stock-minus-PIT-industry resilience measured only on industry-down sessions predict positive, actionable future stock selection beyond ordinary industry-relative strength, realized volatility, liquidity, Low-MAX, and the frozen Strategy-A selection?

universe.source: the exact causal daily feature panel frozen by ASHARE-MULTISCALE-DIFFUSION-DAILY-ALPHA-CYCLE-015
universe.eligibility: hard-valid, PIT lineage-valid, corporate-action-valid, current tradable non-ST rows with 120 consecutive valid stock sessions, exact prior-20 amount history, prior-20 average amount at least CNY 50 million, and at least six same-date PIT-industry peers
universe.industry: historical PIT industry recorded on each observation date; daily stock residual uses the leave-one-out equal-weight mean step log return of eligible same-date same-industry peers
universe.decision_schedule: weekly dates where the authoritative market calendar cal_idx modulo 5 equals 4
universe.history_continuity: signal row and its previous 19 panel observations must have consecutive market cal_idx values; no skipped or unavailable session is silently bridged

timing.signal_window: 20 completed sessions ending with decision session t (t-19 through t)
timing.signal_known_at: after completed close t; decision_at 15:30 Asia/Shanghai
timing.earliest_entry: first accepted legal open strictly after decision session t
timing.delayed_entry: scan forward through accepted suspension, price-limit, and invalid-open states; the first legal buyable open is entry, otherwise the observation is unusable
timing.corporate_actions: accepted QD-010 visible-action treatment; unresolved action or lineage fails closed

primary.name: IND_DOWN_RESILIENCE_20
primary.formula: mean(stock step log return - same-date PIT-industry leave-one-out mean step log return) over observations in t-19..t for which the PIT-industry leave-one-out return is strictly below zero

diagnostic.name: IND_DOWNSIDE_ASYMMETRY_20
diagnostic.formula: mean residual on industry-down observations minus mean residual on industry-nondown observations over t-19..t

generic_relative_strength_control.name: IND_RELATIVE_STRENGTH_20
generic_relative_strength_control.formula: sum of the same stock-minus-PIT-industry daily residual over t-19..t

realized_volatility_control.name: REALIZED_VOLATILITY_20
realized_volatility_control.formula: sample standard deviation of stock step log returns over t-19..t

contexts.primary_industry_pressure: sum of the stock-specific PIT-industry leave-one-out daily log returns over t-4..t is strictly below zero
contexts.secondary_broad_market_pressure: sum of the causal cross-sectional median eligible-stock daily step log return over t-4..t is strictly below zero
contexts.nonpressure_control: the corresponding fixed five-session sum is greater than or equal to zero

cross_section.ranking: within each decision date and industry-pressure context, rank the primary or diagnostic score into Q1 through Q5 with Q5 strongest; deterministic average rank and ceil(5*pct_rank) clipped to 1..5
cross_section.absolute_outcome: net return from first legal post-signal open through the accepted close at each entry-relative horizon, including accepted visible corporate actions and 20 bps per side
cross_section.industry_relative_outcome: stock net outcome minus the same decision-date, initial-PIT-industry mean net outcome among complete actionable eligible observations
cross_section.broad_relative_outcome: stock net outcome minus the same decision-date mean net outcome among complete actionable eligible observations
cross_section.severe_loss: net h20 return at or below -10%
cross_section.mae: minimum accepted marked value from entry through h20 relative to cost, net of entry cost

confound_audit.method: after raw results, divide each decision-date and pressure-context cross-section into fixed coarse terciles of the named control; report pooled within-tercile Q5-minus-Q1 and Q5 industry-relative economics; no fitted multivariate model

strategy_a_independence.low_max: same-date Spearman rank correlation between IND_DOWN_RESILIENCE_20 and negative exact prior-20 MAX return, plus resilience economics inside Low-MAX terciles
strategy_a_independence.champion: overlap with exact arm2_low_max selections in the frozen construction attribution artifact and primary economics after removing those observations
strategy_a_independence.industry_diffusion: descriptive same-date relationship to the existing causal diffusion_score only; no conditioning strategy or A+B construction

actionability.immediate: first following market session open is accepted and buyable
actionability.delayed: a later accepted buyable open exists within 20 following market sessions

promising_alpha_family_requires: economically meaningful positive forward industry-relative Q5 performance
effect not isolated to one horizon
no material contradiction between frozen chronological blocks
not driven by one calendar year
some evidence of distinction from Low-MAX and Strategy A

prohibited: post-2023 rows, outcomes, metadata, hashes, summaries, or indirect use
Strategy-A entry, Industry Diffusion, Low-MAX, weekly schedule, Top-N, holding, weighting, execution, or exit modification
champion timing, filter, exposure, combination, or A+B replay

10-day, 30-day, 60-day, alternate pressure threshold, sector threshold, market-cap threshold, volatility threshold, MA, RSI, support, reclaim, minute-support, price-limit, weighted-composite, or machine-learning rescue
OOS, independent-confirmation, validation, live, or production claims
